On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.en: On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar fills on the battle results screen.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.ja: オン。戦闘結果画面で経験値バーが伸びる間、速いカチカチ音が鳴ります。
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.fr: Activé. Un tic-tac rapide retentit pendant que la barre d'EXP se remplit sur l'écran des résultats de combat.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.it: Attivato. Un ticchettio rapido suona mentre la barra EXP si riempie nella schermata dei risultati.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.de: Ein. Ein schnelles Ticken ertönt, während sich die EXP-Leiste im Kampfergebnis-Bildschirm füllt.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.es: Activado. Se oye un tictac rápido mientras la barra de EXP se llena en la pantalla de resultados.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.ko: 켜짐. 전투 결과 화면에서 경험치 막대가 차는 동안 빠른 틱 소리가 납니다.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.zht: 開啟。在戰鬥結果畫面經驗值條增長時，會播放快速的滴答聲。
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.zhc: 开启。在战斗结果画面经验值条增长时，会播放快速的滴答声。
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.ru: Вкл. Пока полоса опыта заполняется на экране итогов боя, звучит быстрое тиканье.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.th: เปิด. เสียงติ๊กเร็วจะดังขณะแถบ EXP เพิ่มขึ้นในหน้าจอผลการต่อสู้
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.pt: Ligado. Um tique rápido toca enquanto a barra de EXP se enche na tela de resultados.

Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.en: Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the battle results screen.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.ja: オフ。戦闘結果画面で経験値バーは無音で伸びます。
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.fr: Désactivé. La barre d'EXP se remplit en silence sur l'écran des résultats de combat.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.it: Disattivato. La barra EXP si riempie in silenzio nella schermata dei risultati.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.de: Aus. Die EXP-Leiste füllt sich im Kampfergebnis-Bildschirm lautlos.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.es: Desactivado. La barra de EXP se llena en silencio en la pantalla de resultados.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.ko: 꺼짐. 전투 결과 화면에서 경험치 막대가 소리 없이 찹니다.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.zht: 關閉。在戰鬥結果畫面經驗值條會無聲增長。
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.zhc: 关闭。在战斗结果画面经验值条会无声增长。
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.ru: Выкл. Полоса опыта заполняется на экране итогов боя без звука.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.th: ปิด. แถบ EXP จะเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างเงียบ ๆ ในหน้าจอผลการต่อสู้
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.pt: Desligado. A barra de EXP se enche silenciosamente na tela de resultados.

Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.en: Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to one hundred percent.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.ja: 経験値カウント音の音量。0から100パーセント。
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.fr: Volume du tic du compteur d'EXP, de zéro à cent pour cent.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.it: Volume del ticchettio del contatore EXP, da zero a cento percento.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.de: Lautstärke des EXP-Zähler-Tickens, null bis einhundert Prozent.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.es: Volumen del tic del contador de EXP, de cero a cien por ciento.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.zht: 經驗值計數滴答聲的音量，零到一百百分比。
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.zhc: 经验值计数滴答声的音量，零到一百百分比。
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.ru: Громкость тиканья счётчика опыта, от нуля до ста процентов.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.th: ระดับเสียงติ๊กของตัวนับ EXP ตั้งแต่ศูนย์ถึงหนึ่งร้อยเปอร์เซ็นต์
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.pt: Volume do tique do contador de EXP, de zero a cem por cento.

On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.en: On. Audio beacon is the primary navigation aid; turn-by-turn pathfinding is disabled.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ja: オン。オーディオビーコンが主なナビゲーション手段になり、ターンごとの経路案内は無効になります。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.fr: Activé. La balise audio est l'aide à la navigation principale ; le guidage pas à pas est désactivé.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.it: Attivato. Il segnale audio è l'aiuto alla navigazione principale; la guida passo passo è disattivata.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.de: Ein. Das Audiosignal ist die primäre Navigationshilfe; die schrittweise Wegführung ist deaktiviert.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.es: Activado. La baliza de audio es la ayuda de navegación principal; el guiado paso a paso está desactivado.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ko: 켜짐. 오디오 비콘이 기본 내비게이션 보조 수단이 되며, 단계별 경로 안내는 비활성화됩니다.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.zht: 開啟。音訊信標為主要導航輔助；逐步路徑導引將停用。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.zhc: 开启。音频信标为主要导航辅助；逐步路径导引将停用。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ru: Вкл. Звуковой маяк — основное средство навигации; пошаговый поиск пути отключён.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.th: เปิด. บีคอนเสียงเป็นตัวช่วยนำทางหลัก และการนำทางทีละขั้นจะถูกปิด
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.pt: Ligado. A baliza de áudio é o principal auxílio de navegação; a orientação passo a passo é desativada.

Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.en: Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used for navigation.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ja: オフ。ナビゲーションにはターンごとの経路案内が使われます。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.fr: Désactivé. Le guidage pas à pas est utilisé pour la navigation.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.it: Disattivato. Per la navigazione si usa la guida passo passo.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.de: Aus. Für die Navigation wird die schrittweise Wegführung verwendet.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.es: Desactivado. Se usa el guiado paso a paso para la navegación.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ko: 꺼짐. 내비게이션에는 단계별 경로 안내가 사용됩니다.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.zht: 關閉。導航將使用逐步路徑導引。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.zhc: 关闭。导航将使用逐步路径导引。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ru: Выкл. Для навигации используется пошаговый поиск пути.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.th: ปิด. ใช้การนำทางทีละขั้นสำหรับการนำทาง
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.pt: Desligado. A orientação passo a passo é usada para a navegação.

On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.en: On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (auto-dash and encounter toggle). Mod functions move to mod mode.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ja: オン。L3とR3はゲームに渡されます（オートダッシュとエンカウント切替）。Mod機能はModモードに移ります。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.fr: Activé. L3 et R3 sont transmis au jeu (course auto et bascule des rencontres). Les fonctions du mod passent en mode mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.it: Attivato. L3 e R3 vengono passati al gioco (corsa automatica e attivazione incontri). Le funzioni del mod passano alla modalità mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.de: Ein. L3 und R3 werden an das Spiel weitergegeben (Auto-Sprint und Begegnungs-Umschaltung). Mod-Funktionen wechseln in den Mod-Modus.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.es: Activado. L3 y R3 pasan al juego (carrera automática y alternar encuentros). Las funciones del mod pasan al modo mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ko: 켜짐. L3와 R3가 게임으로 전달됩니다(자동 달리기 및 인카운터 전환). 모드 기능은 모드 모드로 이동합니다.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.zht: 開啟。L3與R3會傳遞給遊戲（自動奔跑與遭遇切換）。Mod功能將移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.zhc: 开启。L3与R3会传递给游戏（自动奔跑与遭遇切换）。Mod功能将移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ru: Вкл. L3 и R3 передаются игре (авто-бег и переключение встреч). Функции мода переходят в режим мода.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.th: เปิด. L3 และ R3 จะส่งต่อไปยังเกม (วิ่งอัตโนมัติและสลับการเผชิญหน้า) ฟังก์ชันม็อดจะย้ายไปยังโหมดม็อด
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.pt: Ligado. L3 e R3 são repassados ao jogo (corrida automática e alternar encontros). As funções do mod passam para o modo mod.

Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.en: Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 toggles pathfinding filter; game cannot see them.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ja: オフ。L3はビーコンナビゲーションを切替、R3は経路探索フィルターを切替します。ゲームはこれらを認識しません。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.fr: Désactivé. L3 bascule la navigation par balise ; R3 bascule le filtre de recherche de chemin ; le jeu ne les voit pas.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.it: Disattivato. L3 attiva/disattiva la navigazione con segnale; R3 attiva/disattiva il filtro di ricerca percorso; il gioco non li rileva.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.de: Aus. L3 schaltet die Signal-Navigation um; R3 schaltet den Wegfindungsfilter um; das Spiel erkennt sie nicht.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.es: Desactivado. L3 alterna la navegación por baliza; R3 alterna el filtro de búsqueda de rutas; el juego no los detecta.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ko: 꺼짐. L3는 비콘 내비게이션을, R3는 경로 탐색 필터를 전환합니다. 게임은 이를 인식하지 못합니다.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.zht: 關閉。L3切換信標導航；R3切換尋路篩選；遊戲無法偵測到它們。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.zhc: 关闭。L3切换信标导航；R3切换寻路筛选；游戏无法检测到它们。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ru: Выкл. L3 переключает навигацию по маяку; R3 переключает фильтр поиска пути; игра их не видит.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.th: ปิด. L3 สลับการนำทางด้วยบีคอน; R3 สลับตัวกรองการหาเส้นทาง; เกมจะไม่รับรู้ปุ่มเหล่านี้
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.pt: Desligado. L3 alterna a navegação por baliza; R3 alterna o filtro de busca de caminho; o jogo não os detecta.

On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.en: On. Descriptions and stats announce automatically on focus for items, magic, equipment, and shops.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ja: オン。アイテム、魔法、装備、ショップで、フォーカス時に説明とステータスを自動でアナウンスします。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.fr: Activé. Les descriptions et statistiques sont annoncées automatiquement à la sélection pour les objets, la magie, l'équipement et les boutiques.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.it: Attivato. Descrizioni e statistiche vengono annunciate automaticamente alla selezione per oggetti, magie, equipaggiamento e negozi.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.de: Ein. Beschreibungen und Werte werden bei Fokus automatisch für Gegenstände, Magie, Ausrüstung und Läden angesagt.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.es: Activado. Las descripciones y estadísticas se anuncian automáticamente al enfocar objetos, magia, equipo y tiendas.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ko: 켜짐. 아이템, 마법, 장비, 상점에서 포커스 시 설명과 능력치를 자동으로 안내합니다.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.zht: 開啟。在道具、魔法、裝備與商店中，聚焦時自動播報說明與數值。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.zhc: 开启。在道具、魔法、装备与商店中，聚焦时自动播报说明与数值。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ru: Вкл. Описания и характеристики озвучиваются автоматически при выборе предметов, магии, снаряжения и в магазинах.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.th: เปิด. คำอธิบายและค่าสถานะจะถูกประกาศโดยอัตโนมัติเมื่อโฟกัสที่ไอเทม เวทมนตร์ อุปกรณ์ และร้านค้า
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.pt: Ligado. Descrições e atributos são anunciados automaticamente ao focar itens, magias, equipamentos e lojas.

Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.en: Off. Use the I key to read descriptions on demand.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.ja: オフ。Iキーで必要なときに説明を読み上げます。
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.fr: Désactivé. Utilisez la touche I pour lire les descriptions à la demande.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.it: Disattivato. Usa il tasto I per leggere le descrizioni su richiesta.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.de: Aus. Mit der I-Taste werden Beschreibungen bei Bedarf vorgelesen.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.es: Desactivado. Usa la tecla I para leer las descripciones cuando quieras.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.ko: 꺼짐. I 키를 눌러 필요할 때 설명을 읽습니다.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.zht: 關閉。需要時按I鍵讀出說明。
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.zhc: 关闭。需要时按I键读出说明。
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.ru: Выкл. Нажмите клавишу I, чтобы прочитать описание при необходимости.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.th: ปิด. ใช้ปุ่ม I เพื่ออ่านคำอธิบายเมื่อต้องการ
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.pt: Desligado. Use a tecla I para ler as descrições quando quiser.

On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.en: On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks the current destination.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ja: オン。ビーコンを再開すると、現在の目的地も再度読み上げます。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.fr: Activé. Redémarrer la balise réannonce aussi la destination actuelle.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.it: Attivato. Riavviando il segnale viene riannunciata anche la destinazione attuale.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.de: Ein. Beim Neustart des Signals wird auch das aktuelle Ziel erneut angesagt.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.es: Activado. Reiniciar la baliza también vuelve a anunciar el destino actual.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ko: 켜짐. 비콘을 다시 시작하면 현재 목적지도 다시 안내합니다.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.zht: 開啟。重新啟動信標時也會再次播報目前的目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.zhc: 开启。重新启动信标时也会再次播报当前的目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ru: Вкл. При перезапуске маяка также повторно озвучивается текущий пункт назначения.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.th: เปิด. การเริ่มบีคอนใหม่จะประกาศจุดหมายปัจจุบันซ้ำด้วย
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.pt: Ligado. Reiniciar a baliza também reanuncia o destino atual.

Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.en: Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings, without speaking.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.ja: オフ。ビーコンを再開しても、読み上げずにピング音だけを鳴らします。
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.fr: Désactivé. Redémarrer la balise relance seulement le signal sonore, sans annonce.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.it: Disattivato. Riavviando il segnale viene solo riprodotto il ping, senza annunci.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.de: Aus. Beim Neustart des Signals ertönt nur erneut der Ping, ohne Ansage.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.es: Desactivado. Reiniciar la baliza solo vuelve a emitir el pitido, sin hablar.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.ko: 꺼짐. 비콘을 다시 시작해도 안내 없이 핑 소리만 다시 울립니다.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.zht: 關閉。重新啟動信標時只會再次發出提示音，不會播報。
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.zhc: 关闭。重新启动信标时只会再次发出提示音，不会播报。

On. Directional tones play as you approa.en: On. Directional tones play as you approach walls.

On. Directional tones play as you approa.it: Attivato. Toni direzionali suonano quando ti avvicini ai muri.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.de: Ein. Richtungstöne erklingen, wenn du dich Wänden näherst.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.es: Activado. Suenan tonos direccionales al acercarte a las paredes.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.ko: 켜짐. 벽에 가까워지면 방향 신호음이 재생됩니다.

Off. No directional wall feedback..ja: オフ。壁の方向フィードバックはありません。

Off. No directional wall feedback..es: Desactivado. Sin aviso direccional de paredes.
Off. No directional wall feedback..zht: 關閉。沒有牆壁方向提示。
Off. No directional wall feedback..zhc: 关闭。没有墙壁方向提示。

Off. No directional wall feedback..pt: Desligado. Sem aviso direcional de paredes.

On. A click plays for each tile of playe.ja: オン。1マス移動するごとにクリック音が鳴ります。
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.fr: Activé. Un clic retentit à chaque case parcourue.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.it: Attivato. Un clic suona a ogni casella percorsa.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.de: Ein. Bei jedem Feld, das du gehst, ertönt ein Klick.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.es: Activado. Suena un clic por cada casilla que avanzas.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.ko: 켜짐. 한 칸 이동할 때마다 클릭음이 재생됩니다.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.zht: 開啟。每移動一格播放一次點擊聲。
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.zhc: 开启。每移动一格播放一次点击声。
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.ru: Вкл. Щелчок звучит на каждой клетке движения.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.th: เปิด. เสียงคลิกจะดังทุกครั้งที่เดินหนึ่งช่อง
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.pt: Ligado. Um clique toca a cada casa percorrida.

Off. No per-tile movement sound..zht: 關閉。移動時不播放每格音效。
Off. No per-tile movement sound..zhc: 关闭。移动时不播放每格音效。
Off. No per-tile movement sound..ru: Выкл. Без звука на каждой клетке.
Off. No per-tile movement sound..th: ปิด. ไม่มีเสียงเมื่อเดินแต่ละช่อง
Off. No per-tile movement sound..pt: Desligado. Sem som a cada casa.

On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.en: On. Entity cycling shows only entities reachable via pathfinding.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ja: オン。エンティティの切り替えでは、経路探索で到達できるものだけを表示します。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.fr: Activé. Le parcours des entités n'affiche que celles accessibles par un chemin.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.it: Attivato. Lo scorrimento delle entità mostra solo quelle raggiungibili tramite percorso.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.de: Ein. Beim Durchblättern werden nur Objekte angezeigt, die per Wegfindung erreichbar sind.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.es: Activado. Al recorrer las entidades solo se muestran las accesibles por ruta.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ko: 켜짐. 개체 순환 시 경로 탐색으로 도달 가능한 개체만 표시합니다.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.zht: 開啟。切換實體時只顯示可經由尋路到達的實體。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.zhc: 开启。切换实体时只显示可经由寻路到达的实体。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ru: Вкл. При переборе объектов показываются только доступные по маршруту.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.th: เปิด. การวนดูสิ่งของจะแสดงเฉพาะสิ่งที่เดินไปถึงได้
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.pt: Ligado. Ao percorrer as entidades, só aparecem as alcançáveis por caminho.

Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.en: Off. All entities appear when cycling, including unreachable ones.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ja: オフ。到達できないものも含め、すべてのエンティティを表示します。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.fr: Désactivé. Toutes les entités apparaissent, y compris celles inaccessibles.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.it: Disattivato. Compaiono tutte le entità, anche quelle irraggiungibili.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.de: Aus. Alle Objekte werden angezeigt, auch unerreichbare.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.es: Desactivado. Aparecen todas las entidades, incluso las inaccesibles.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ko: 꺼짐. 도달할 수 없는 개체를 포함해 모든 개체가 표시됩니다.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.zht: 關閉。切換時會顯示所有實體，包括無法到達的。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.zhc: 关闭。切换时会显示所有实体，包括无法到达的。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ru: Выкл. При переборе показываются все объекты, включая недоступные.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.th: ปิด. แสดงสิ่งของทั้งหมดเมื่อวนดู รวมถึงสิ่งที่เดินไปไม่ถึง
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.pt: Desligado. Todas as entidades aparecem, inclusive as inalcançáveis.

On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.en: On. Multiple exits leading to the same destination collapse to the closest one.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ja: オン。同じ行き先への複数の出口は、最も近いもの1つにまとめます。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.fr: Activé. Les sorties menant à la même destination sont regroupées en la plus proche.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.it: Attivato. Le uscite verso la stessa destinazione vengono unite nella più vicina.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.de: Ein. Mehrere Ausgänge zum selben Ziel werden zum nächstgelegenen zusammengefasst.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.es: Activado. Las salidas que llevan al mismo destino se agrupan en la más cercana.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ko: 켜짐. 같은 목적지로 가는 여러 출구를 가장 가까운 하나로 합칩니다.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.zht: 開啟。通往相同目的地的多個出口會合併為最近的一個。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.zhc: 开启。通往相同目的地的多个出口会合并为最近的一个。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ru: Вкл. Несколько выходов в одно место объединяются в ближайший.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.th: เปิด. ทางออกหลายทางที่ไปยังจุดหมายเดียวกันจะรวมเหลือทางที่ใกล้ที่สุด
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.pt: Ligado. Várias saídas para o mesmo destino são agrupadas na mais próxima.

On. A ping sounds toward the selected de.en: On. A ping sounds toward the selected destination, and the pathfind keys restart it instead of speaking directions.
On. A ping sounds toward the selected de.ja: オン。選択した目的地の方向からピン音が鳴り、経路キーは道順を読み上げる代わりにピン音を再開します。

On. A ping sounds toward the selected de.zhc: 开启。朝所选目的地方向播放提示音，寻路键会重新开始提示音而不是读出路线。
On. A ping sounds toward the selected de.ru: Вкл. Сигнал звучит в сторону выбранной цели, а клавиши маршрута перезапускают его вместо озвучивания пути.
On. A ping sounds toward the selected de.th: เปิด มีเสียงสัญญาณไปทางจุดหมายที่เลือก และปุ่มหาเส้นทางจะเริ่มสัญญาณใหม่แทนการอ่านเส้นทาง
On. A ping sounds toward the selected de.pt: Ligado. Um sinal toca na direção do destino escolhido, e as teclas de rota o reiniciam em vez de falar o caminho.

On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.ko: 켜짐. 전투 후 경험치 바가 차는 동안 빠른 틱 소리가 납니다.

On. Descriptions and stats are read auto.en: On. Descriptions and stats are read automatically for items, spells, equipment and shop goods.

On. Descriptions and stats are read auto.th: เปิด อ่านคำอธิบายและค่าสถานะของไอเทม เวทมนตร์ อุปกรณ์ และสินค้าในร้านโดยอัตโนมัติ

On. Exits leading to the same map are me.en: On. Exits leading to the same map are merged into the closest one.
On. Exits leading to the same map are me.ja: オン。同じマップへ通じる出口は最も近いものにまとめます。

On. Exits leading to the same map are me.th: เปิด ทางออกที่ไปแผนที่เดียวกันจะรวมเป็นทางที่ใกล้ที่สุด
On. Exits leading to the same map are me.pt: Ligado. Saídas para o mesmo mapa são agrupadas na mais próxima.

Left and Right change the volume in step.en: Left and Right change the volume in steps of 5 percent. Enter mutes it, or sets it to 50 percent when muted.
Left and Right change the volume in step.ja: 左右で音量を5%ずつ変更。Enterでミュート、ミュート中なら50%に設定。
Left and Right change the volume in step.fr: Gauche et droite changent le volume par paliers de 5 %. Entrée coupe le son, ou le règle à 50 % s'il est coupé.
Left and Right change the volume in step.it: Sinistra e destra cambiano il volume a passi del 5%. Invio lo silenzia, o lo imposta al 50% se è silenziato.
Left and Right change the volume in step.de: Links und rechts ändern die Lautstärke in 5-Prozent-Schritten. Eingabe schaltet stumm oder setzt sie, wenn stumm, auf 50 Prozent.
Left and Right change the volume in step.es: Izquierda y derecha cambian el volumen en pasos del 5 %. Intro lo silencia, o lo pone al 50 % si está silenciado.
Left and Right change the volume in step.ko: 좌우로 음량을 5%씩 변경합니다. Enter로 음소거하며, 음소거 상태에서는 50%로 설정합니다.
Left and Right change the volume in step.zht: 左右以5%為單位調整音量。Enter靜音；靜音時則設為50%。
Left and Right change the volume in step.zhc: 左右以5%为单位调整音量。Enter静音；静音时则设为50%。
Left and Right change the volume in step.ru: Влево и вправо меняют громкость с шагом 5 процентов. Enter выключает звук, а если он выключен, ставит 50 процентов.
Left and Right change the volume in step.th: ซ้ายขวาเปลี่ยนระดับเสียงทีละ 5 เปอร์เซ็นต์ Enter เพื่อปิดเสียง หรือตั้งเป็น 50 เปอร์เซ็นต์เมื่อปิดเสียงอยู่
Left and Right change the volume in step.pt: Esquerda e direita mudam o volume em passos de 5%. Enter silencia, ou define em 50% se estiver silenciado.

On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.en: On. Tones sound toward any wall right next to you.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.ja: オン。すぐ隣の壁の方向から音が鳴ります。
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.fr: Activé. Un son indique la direction de tout mur juste à côté de vous.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.it: Attivato. Un suono indica la direzione di ogni muro subito accanto a te.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.de: Ein. Ein Ton erklingt in Richtung jeder direkt angrenzenden Wand.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.es: Activado. Suena un tono hacia cualquier pared justo a tu lado.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.ko: 켜짐. 바로 옆에 있는 벽 방향에서 소리가 납니다.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.zht: 開啟。緊鄰的牆壁方向會發出音效。
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.zhc: 开启。紧邻的墙壁方向会发出音效。
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.ru: Вкл. Звук раздаётся со стороны любой стены рядом с вами.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.th: เปิด มีเสียงดังจากทิศของกำแพงที่อยู่ติดกับคุณ
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.pt: Ligado. Um som toca na direção de qualquer parede logo ao seu lado.

Off. No wall tones..ja: オフ。壁の音は鳴りません。
Off. No wall tones..th: ปิด ไม่มีเสียงกำแพง

On. A click plays for every tile you mov.en: On. A click plays for every tile you move.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.ja: オン。1マス移動するごとにクリック音が鳴ります。
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.fr: Activé. Un clic retentit à chaque case parcourue.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.it: Attivato. Un clic suona per ogni casella percorsa.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.de: Ein. Bei jedem Feld, das du gehst, ertönt ein Klick.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.es: Activado. Suena un clic por cada casilla que avanzas.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.ko: 켜짐. 한 칸 이동할 때마다 클릭 소리가 납니다.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.zht: 開啟。每移動一格就發出喀嗒聲。
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.zhc: 开启。每移动一格就发出咔嗒声。
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.ru: Вкл. Щелчок звучит на каждой пройденной клетке.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.th: เปิด มีเสียงคลิกทุกครั้งที่เดินหนึ่งช่อง
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.pt: Ligado. Um clique toca a cada casa percorrida.

Off. Movement is silent..ja: オフ。移動しても音は鳴りません。
Off. Movement is silent..th: ปิด การเคลื่อนที่ไม่มีเสียง

On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.en: On. Choosing a destination starts an audio beacon instead of spoken directions.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.ja: オン。目的地を選ぶと、音声による道案内の代わりにビーコン音が鳴ります。
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.fr: Activé. Choisir une destination lance une balise sonore au lieu d'indications vocales.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.it: Attivato. Scegliere una destinazione avvia un segnale audio invece delle indicazioni vocali.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.de: Ein. Die Wahl eines Ziels startet ein Audiosignal statt gesprochener Wegbeschreibung.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.es: Activado. Al elegir un destino suena una baliza de audio en lugar de indicaciones habladas.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.ko: 켜짐. 목적지를 고르면 음성 길 안내 대신 오디오 비콘이 울립니다.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.zht: 開啟。選擇目的地時會播放音訊信標，而不是語音指引。
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.zhc: 开启。选择目的地时会播放音频信标，而不是语音指引。
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.ru: Вкл. При выборе цели включается звуковой маяк вместо голосовых указаний.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.th: เปิด เมื่อเลือกจุดหมายจะมีสัญญาณเสียงแทนการบอกทางด้วยเสียงพูด
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.pt: Ligado. Escolher um destino inicia um sinal de áudio em vez de instruções faladas.

Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.en: Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-by-step directions.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.ja: オフ。目的地を選ぶと、道順を読み上げます。
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.fr: Désactivé. Choisir une destination énonce l'itinéraire pas à pas.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.it: Disattivato. Scegliere una destinazione legge il percorso passo per passo.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.de: Aus. Die Wahl eines Ziels liest den Weg Schritt für Schritt vor.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.es: Desactivado. Al elegir un destino se leen las indicaciones paso a paso.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.ko: 꺼짐. 목적지를 고르면 단계별 길 안내를 읽어 줍니다.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.zht: 關閉。選擇目的地時會逐步朗讀路線。
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.zhc: 关闭。选择目的地时会逐步朗读路线。
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.ru: Выкл. При выборе цели маршрут зачитывается пошагово.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.th: ปิด เมื่อเลือกจุดหมายจะอ่านเส้นทางทีละขั้น
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.pt: Desligado. Escolher um destino lê o caminho passo a passo.

On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.en: On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod functions move to mod mode.
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.ja: オン。L3とR3はゲームに送られ、Modの機能はModモードに移ります。
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.fr: Activé. L3 et R3 vont au jeu ; leurs fonctions du mod passent en mode mod.
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.it: Attivato. L3 e R3 vanno al gioco; le loro funzioni della mod passano alla modalità mod.
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.de: Ein. L3 und R3 gehen an das Spiel; ihre Mod-Funktionen wandern in den Mod-Modus.
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.es: Activado. L3 y R3 van al juego; sus funciones del mod pasan al modo mod.
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.ko: 켜짐. L3와 R3는 게임으로 전달되고, 모드 기능은 모드 모드로 옮겨집니다.
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.zht: 開啟。L3與R3交給遊戲，其Mod功能移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.zhc: 开启。L3与R3交给游戏，其Mod功能移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.ru: Вкл. L3 и R3 передаются игре; их функции мода переходят в режим мода.
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.th: เปิด L3 และ R3 ส่งให้เกม ฟังก์ชันม็อดของปุ่มเหล่านี้ย้ายไปอยู่ในโหมดม็อด
On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.pt: Ligado. L3 e R3 vão para o jogo; suas funções do mod passam para o modo mod.

Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.en: Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3 the pathfinding filter.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.ja: オフ。L3でビーコンナビゲーション、R3で経路探索フィルターを切り替えます。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.fr: Désactivé. L3 bascule la navigation par balise et R3 le filtre de recherche de chemin.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.it: Disattivato. L3 attiva o disattiva la navigazione a segnale e R3 il filtro percorso.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.de: Aus. L3 schaltet die Signal-Navigation um und R3 den Pfadfindungsfilter.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.es: Desactivado. L3 alterna la navegación por baliza y R3 el filtro de búsqueda de ruta.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.ko: 꺼짐. L3는 비콘 내비게이션, R3는 경로 탐색 필터를 전환합니다.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.zht: 關閉。L3切換信標導航，R3切換尋路篩選。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.zhc: 关闭。L3切换信标导航，R3切换寻路筛选。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.ru: Выкл. L3 переключает навигацию по маяку, R3 — фильтр поиска пути.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.th: ปิด L3 สลับการนำทางด้วยสัญญาณเสียง และ R3 สลับตัวกรองการค้นหาเส้นทาง
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation and R3.pt: Desligado. L3 alterna a navegação por sinal e R3 o filtro de busca de caminho.

On. Menu entries end with their position.en: On. Menu entries end with their position, such as 3 of 12.
On. Menu entries end with their position.ja: オン。メニュー項目の最後に位置を読み上げます。例: 12中3。
On. Menu entries end with their position.fr: Activé. Les entrées de menu se terminent par leur position, par exemple 3 sur 12.
On. Menu entries end with their position.it: Attivato. Le voci di menu terminano con la loro posizione, ad esempio 3 di 12.
On. Menu entries end with their position.de: Ein. Menüeinträge enden mit ihrer Position, zum Beispiel 3 von 12.
On. Menu entries end with their position.es: Activado. Las entradas del menú terminan con su posición, por ejemplo 3 de 12.
On. Menu entries end with their position.ko: 켜짐. 메뉴 항목 끝에 위치를 읽어 줍니다. 예: 12 중 3.
On. Menu entries end with their position.zht: 開啟。選單項目最後會讀出位置，例如 3 / 12。
On. Menu entries end with their position.zhc: 开启。菜单项目最后会读出位置，例如 3 / 12。
On. Menu entries end with their position.ru: Вкл. В конце пункта меню называется его позиция, например 3 из 12.
On. Menu entries end with their position.th: เปิด รายการเมนูจะบอกตำแหน่งท้ายสุด เช่น 3 จาก 12
On. Menu entries end with their position.pt: Ligado. As entradas do menu terminam com a posição, por exemplo 3 de 12.

Off. Menu entries are read without their.en: Off. Menu entries are read without their position.
Off. Menu entries are read without their.ja: オフ。メニュー項目の位置は読み上げません。
Off. Menu entries are read without their.fr: Désactivé. Les entrées de menu sont lues sans leur position.
Off. Menu entries are read without their.it: Disattivato. Le voci di menu vengono lette senza la posizione.
Off. Menu entries are read without their.de: Aus. Menüeinträge werden ohne ihre Position vorgelesen.
Off. Menu entries are read without their.es: Desactivado. Las entradas del menú se leen sin su posición.
Off. Menu entries are read without their.ko: 꺼짐. 메뉴 항목의 위치는 읽지 않습니다.
Off. Menu entries are read without their.zht: 關閉。選單項目不讀出位置。
Off. Menu entries are read without their.zhc: 关闭。菜单项目不读出位置。
Off. Menu entries are read without their.ru: Выкл. Пункты меню читаются без позиции.
Off. Menu entries are read without their.th: ปิด อ่านรายการเมนูโดยไม่บอกตำแหน่ง
Off. Menu entries are read without their.pt: Desligado. As entradas do menu são lidas sem a posição.

On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.en: On. Descriptions are read as soon as an item, spell or shop entry is focused.
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.ja: オン。アイテム、魔法、ショップの項目を選んだ時点で説明を読み上げます。
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.fr: Activé. Les descriptions sont lues dès qu'un objet, un sort ou un article de boutique est sélectionné.
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.it: Attivato. Le descrizioni vengono lette non appena si seleziona un oggetto, una magia o un articolo del negozio.
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.de: Ein. Beschreibungen werden vorgelesen, sobald ein Gegenstand, Zauber oder Ladeneintrag ausgewählt ist.
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.es: Activado. Las descripciones se leen en cuanto se selecciona un objeto, un hechizo o un artículo de la tienda.
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.ko: 켜짐. 아이템, 마법, 상점 항목에 커서를 두면 바로 설명을 읽어 줍니다.
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.zht: 開啟。選中道具、魔法或商店項目時立即讀出說明。
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.zhc: 开启。选中道具、魔法或商店项目时立即读出说明。
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.ru: Вкл. Описание читается сразу при выборе предмета, заклинания или товара.
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.th: เปิด อ่านคำอธิบายทันทีเมื่อเลือกไอเท็ม เวทมนตร์ หรือสินค้าในร้าน
On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.pt: Ligado. As descrições são lidas assim que um item, magia ou artigo da loja é selecionado.

Off. Press I to hear the description of.en: Off. Press I to hear the description of the focused entry.
Off. Press I to hear the description of.ja: オフ。Iキーで選択中の項目の説明を聞けます。
Off. Press I to hear the description of.fr: Désactivé. Appuyez sur I pour entendre la description de l'entrée sélectionnée.
Off. Press I to hear the description of.it: Disattivato. Premi I per ascoltare la descrizione della voce selezionata.
Off. Press I to hear the description of.de: Aus. Drücke I, um die Beschreibung des ausgewählten Eintrags zu hören.
Off. Press I to hear the description of.es: Desactivado. Pulsa I para oír la descripción de la entrada seleccionada.
Off. Press I to hear the description of.ko: 꺼짐. I 키를 누르면 선택한 항목의 설명을 들을 수 있습니다.
Off. Press I to hear the description of.zht: 關閉。按I鍵聽取選中項目的說明。
Off. Press I to hear the description of.zhc: 关闭。按I键听取选中项目的说明。
Off. Press I to hear the description of.ru: Выкл. Нажмите I, чтобы услышать описание выбранного пункта.
Off. Press I to hear the description of.th: ปิด กด I เพื่อฟังคำอธิบายของรายการที่เลือก
Off. Press I to hear the description of.pt: Desligado. Pressione I para ouvir a descrição da entrada selecionada.

On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.en: On. Entity lists skip anything you cannot walk to.
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.ja: オン。歩いてたどり着けないものはエンティティ一覧から除外します。
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.fr: Activé. Les listes d'entités ignorent tout ce que vous ne pouvez pas atteindre à pied.
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.it: Attivato. Gli elenchi di entità escludono ciò che non puoi raggiungere a piedi.
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.de: Ein. Objektlisten überspringen alles, was du nicht zu Fuß erreichen kannst.
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.es: Activado. Las listas de entidades omiten todo lo que no puedes alcanzar a pie.
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.ko: 켜짐. 걸어서 갈 수 없는 것은 개체 목록에서 제외합니다.
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.zht: 開啟。實體列表會略過無法步行抵達的項目。
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.zhc: 开启。实体列表会略过无法步行抵达的项目。
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.ru: Вкл. Списки объектов пропускают всё, до чего нельзя дойти.
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.th: เปิด รายการสิ่งต่าง ๆ จะข้ามสิ่งที่เดินไปไม่ถึง
On. Entity lists skip anything you canno.pt: Ligado. As listas de entidades ignoram tudo o que não dá para alcançar a pé.

Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.en: Off. Entity lists include unreachable entities.
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.ja: オフ。たどり着けないエンティティも一覧に含めます。
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.fr: Désactivé. Les listes d'entités incluent les entités inaccessibles.
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.it: Disattivato. Gli elenchi di entità includono quelle irraggiungibili.
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.de: Aus. Objektlisten enthalten auch unerreichbare Objekte.
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.es: Desactivado. Las listas de entidades incluyen las inalcanzables.
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.ko: 꺼짐. 갈 수 없는 개체도 목록에 포함합니다.
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.zht: 關閉。實體列表包含無法抵達的項目。
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.zhc: 关闭。实体列表包含无法抵达的项目。
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.th: ปิด รายการสิ่งต่าง ๆ รวมสิ่งที่ไปไม่ถึงด้วย
Off. Entity lists include unreachable en.pt: Desligado. As listas de entidades incluem as inalcançáveis.

On. Exits leading to the same place are.en: On. Exits leading to the same place are merged into the closest one.
On. Exits leading to the same place are.ja: オン。同じ場所に通じる出口は、いちばん近いものにまとめます。
On. Exits leading to the same place are.fr: Activé. Les sorties menant au même endroit sont regroupées en la plus proche.

Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.en: Pings the selected entity or waypoint, panned toward it and faster as you get closer. A lower pitch means there is no path. While on, backslash and P restart the beacon instead of reading directions.
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.ja: 選択中の対象またはウェイポイントの方向から音を鳴らし、近づくほど間隔が短くなります。音が低い場合は経路がありません。オンの間は、バックスラッシュとPキーで道順を読み上げる代わりにビーコンを再開します。
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.fr: Émet un signal depuis la direction de l'entité ou du point de repère sélectionné, de plus en plus rapide à mesure que vous approchez. Un son plus grave signifie qu'il n'y a pas de chemin. Quand cette option est activée, la barre oblique inverse et P relancent la balise au lieu de lire l'itinéraire.
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.it: Emette un segnale dalla direzione dell'entità o del punto di riferimento selezionato, sempre più rapido man mano che ti avvicini. Un tono più basso indica che non c'è un percorso. Quando è attivo, la barra rovesciata e P riavviano il segnale invece di leggere le indicazioni.
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.de: Sendet ein Signal aus der Richtung des gewählten Objekts oder Wegpunkts, das schneller wird, je näher du kommst. Ein tieferer Ton bedeutet, dass es keinen Weg gibt. Solange aktiv, starten Backslash und P das Signal neu, statt die Wegbeschreibung vorzulesen.
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.es: Emite un sonido desde la dirección de la entidad o punto de referencia seleccionado, más rápido a medida que te acercas. Un tono más grave indica que no hay ruta. Mientras está activado, la barra invertida y P reinician la baliza en lugar de leer las indicaciones.
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.ko: 선택한 대상이나 경유지 방향에서 신호음을 재생하며, 가까워질수록 빨라집니다. 음이 낮으면 경로가 없다는 뜻입니다. 켜져 있는 동안 백슬래시와 P 키는 길 안내를 읽는 대신 비콘을 다시 시작합니다.
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.zht: 從選取的目標或路標點方向發出提示音，越接近越快。音調較低表示沒有路徑。開啟時，反斜線與P鍵會重新啟動信標，而不是朗讀路線。
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.zhc: 从选中的目标或路标点方向发出提示音，越接近越快。音调较低表示没有路径。开启时，反斜杠与P键会重新启动信标，而不是朗读路线。
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.ru: Подаёт сигнал со стороны выбранного объекта или путевой точки, всё чаще по мере приближения. Более низкий тон означает, что пути нет. Пока включено, обратная косая черта и P перезапускают маяк вместо чтения маршрута.
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.th: ส่งเสียงจากทิศทางของวัตถุหรือจุดอ้างอิงที่เลือก และถี่ขึ้นเมื่อเข้าใกล้ เสียงต่ำหมายความว่าไม่มีเส้นทาง ขณะเปิดอยู่ ปุ่มแบ็กสแลชและ P จะเริ่มสัญญาณใหม่แทนการอ่านเส้นทาง
Pings the selected entity or waypoint, p.pt: Emite um sinal na direção da entidade ou ponto de referência selecionado, mais rápido conforme você se aproxima. Um tom mais grave indica que não há caminho. Enquanto ativado, a barra invertida e P reiniciam o sinal em vez de ler o trajeto.

While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.en: While riding a vehicle, pings the directions in which you can land or get off.
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.ja: 乗り物に乗っている間、着陸や降りることができる方向を音で知らせます。
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.fr: En véhicule, signale les directions dans lesquelles vous pouvez atterrir ou descendre.
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.it: Mentre sei su un veicolo, segnala le direzioni in cui puoi atterrare o scendere.
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.de: Meldet während einer Fahrt die Richtungen, in denen du landen oder aussteigen kannst.
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.es: Mientras vas en un vehículo, indica con sonidos las direcciones en las que puedes aterrizar o bajar.
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.ko: 탈것에 타고 있는 동안 착륙하거나 내릴 수 있는 방향을 소리로 알려 줍니다.
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.zht: 乘坐載具時，以提示音告知可以降落或下來的方向。
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.zhc: 乘坐载具时，以提示音告知可以降落或下来的方向。
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.ru: Во время поездки на транспорте подаёт сигналы в тех направлениях, где можно приземлиться или сойти.
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.th: ขณะขี่ยานพาหนะ จะส่งเสียงบอกทิศทางที่สามารถลงจอดหรือลงจากยานได้
While riding a vehicle, pings the direct.pt: Enquanto você estiver em um veículo, sinaliza as direções em que é possível pousar ou desembarcar.

When you restart the audio beacon, also.en: When you restart the audio beacon, also reads the directions to its destination.
When you restart the audio beacon, also.ja: 音声ビーコンを再開したときに、目的地までの道順も読み上げます。
When you restart the audio beacon, also.fr: Quand vous relancez la balise audio, lit aussi l'itinéraire vers sa destination.
When you restart the audio beacon, also.it: Quando riavvii il segnale audio, legge anche le indicazioni per la sua destinazione.
When you restart the audio beacon, also.de: Liest beim Neustart des Audio-Signals auch die Wegbeschreibung zum Ziel vor.
When you restart the audio beacon, also.es: Al reiniciar la baliza de audio, también lee las indicaciones hasta su destino.
When you restart the audio beacon, also.ko: 오디오 비콘을 다시 시작할 때 목적지까지의 길 안내도 읽어 줍니다.
When you restart the audio beacon, also.zht: 重新啟動音訊信標時，同時朗讀前往目的地的路線。
When you restart the audio beacon, also.zhc: 重新启动音频信标时，同时朗读前往目的地的路线。
When you restart the audio beacon, also.ru: При перезапуске звукового маяка также зачитывает маршрут до цели.
When you restart the audio beacon, also.th: เมื่อเริ่มสัญญาณเสียงใหม่ จะอ่านเส้นทางไปยังจุดหมายด้วย
When you restart the audio beacon, also.pt: Ao reiniciar o sinal de áudio, também lê o trajeto até o destino.

Adds the position in the list to menu en.en: Adds the position in the list to menu entries, for example 3 of 12.
Adds the position in the list to menu en.ja: メニュー項目にリスト内の位置を付け加えます。例: 12中3。
Adds the position in the list to menu en.fr: Ajoute la position dans la liste aux entrées de menu, par exemple 3 sur 12.
Adds the position in the list to menu en.it: Aggiunge alle voci di menu la posizione nell'elenco, ad esempio 3 di 12.
Adds the position in the list to menu en.de: Ergänzt Menüeinträge um die Position in der Liste, zum Beispiel 3 von 12.
Adds the position in the list to menu en.es: Añade a las entradas de menú su posición en la lista, por ejemplo 3 de 12.
Adds the position in the list to menu en.ko: 메뉴 항목에 목록 내 위치를 덧붙입니다. 예: 12 중 3.
Adds the position in the list to menu en.zht: 在選單項目後加上其在清單中的位置，例如 3/12。
Adds the position in the list to menu en.zhc: 在菜单项目后加上其在列表中的位置，例如 3/12。
Adds the position in the list to menu en.ru: Добавляет к пунктам меню их позицию в списке, например 3 из 12.
Adds the position in the list to menu en.th: เพิ่มตำแหน่งในรายการให้กับรายการเมนู เช่น 3 จาก 12
Adds the position in the list to menu en.pt: Adiciona a posição na lista aos itens de menu, por exemplo 3 de 12.

Reads descriptions automatically as you.en: Reads descriptions automatically as you move through items, abilities, equipment and shops. When off, press I for details.
Reads descriptions automatically as you.ja: アイテム、アビリティ、装備、ショップで項目を移動すると説明を自動で読み上げます。オフのときはIキーで詳細を確認できます。
Reads descriptions automatically as you.fr: Lit automatiquement les descriptions lorsque vous parcourez les objets, aptitudes, équipements et boutiques. Si désactivé, appuyez sur I pour les détails.
Reads descriptions automatically as you.it: Legge automaticamente le descrizioni mentre scorri oggetti, abilità, equipaggiamento e negozi. Se disattivato, premi I per i dettagli.
Reads descriptions automatically as you.de: Liest Beschreibungen automatisch vor, während du durch Gegenstände, Fähigkeiten, Ausrüstung und Läden navigierst. Wenn aus, drücke I für Details.
Reads descriptions automatically as you.es: Lee las descripciones automáticamente al recorrer objetos, habilidades, equipo y tiendas. Si está desactivado, pulsa I para ver los detalles.
Reads descriptions automatically as you.ko: 아이템, 어빌리티, 장비, 상점을 탐색할 때 설명을 자동으로 읽어 줍니다. 꺼져 있으면 I 키로 상세 정보를 들을 수 있습니다.
Reads descriptions automatically as you.zht: 瀏覽道具、能力、裝備與商店時自動朗讀說明。關閉時，按I鍵查看詳細資訊。
Reads descriptions automatically as you.zhc: 浏览道具、能力、装备与商店时自动朗读说明。关闭时，按I键查看详细信息。
Reads descriptions automatically as you.ru: Автоматически зачитывает описания при перемещении по предметам, способностям, снаряжению и магазинам. Когда выключено, нажмите I для подробностей.
Reads descriptions automatically as you.th: อ่านคำอธิบายโดยอัตโนมัติขณะเลื่อนดูไอเทม ความสามารถ อุปกรณ์ และร้านค้า เมื่อปิดอยู่ ให้กด I เพื่อฟังรายละเอียด
Reads descriptions automatically as you.pt: Lê as descrições automaticamente ao percorrer itens, habilidades, equipamentos e lojas. Quando desativado, pressione I para ver os detalhes.

Volume of the sound played when you walk.en: Volume of the sound played when you walk into a wall.
Volume of the sound played when you walk.ja: 壁にぶつかったときの音の音量です。
Volume of the sound played when you walk.fr: Volume du son joué quand vous heurtez un mur.
Volume of the sound played when you walk.it: Volume del suono riprodotto quando urti un muro.
Volume of the sound played when you walk.de: Lautstärke des Tons, wenn du gegen eine Wand läufst.
Volume of the sound played when you walk.es: Volumen del sonido al chocar contra una pared.
Volume of the sound played when you walk.ko: 벽에 부딪혔을 때 재생되는 소리의 음량입니다.
Volume of the sound played when you walk.zht: 撞到牆壁時播放的音效音量。
Volume of the sound played when you walk.zhc: 撞到墙壁时播放的音效音量。
Volume of the sound played when you walk.ru: Громкость звука при столкновении со стеной.
Volume of the sound played when you walk.th: ระดับเสียงที่เล่นเมื่อเดินชนกำแพง
Volume of the sound played when you walk.pt: Volume do som tocado quando você esbarra em uma parede.

Volume of the footstep clicks..es: Volumen de los clics de pasos.
Volume of the footstep clicks..th: ระดับเสียงคลิกของฝีเท้า

Volume of the wall tones..es: Volumen de los tonos de pared.

Volume of the audio beacon pings..ja: 音声ビーコンの音量です。
Volume of the audio beacon pings..fr: Volume des signaux de la balise audio.
Volume of the audio beacon pings..es: Volumen de los sonidos de la baliza de audio.
Volume of the audio beacon pings..zht: 音訊信標提示音的音量。
Volume of the audio beacon pings..zhc: 音频信标提示音的音量。

Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.en: Entity cycling skips anything you cannot currently walk to.
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.ja: 対象の切り替え時に、現在歩いて行けないものを飛ばします。
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.fr: Le parcours des entités ignore tout ce que vous ne pouvez pas atteindre à pied pour le moment.
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.it: Lo scorrimento delle entità salta ciò che al momento non puoi raggiungere a piedi.
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.de: Beim Durchschalten der Objekte wird alles übersprungen, was du gerade nicht erreichen kannst.
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.es: Al recorrer entidades se omite todo lo que no puedes alcanzar caminando en este momento.
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.ko: 대상을 전환할 때 지금 걸어서 갈 수 없는 것은 건너뜁니다.
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.zht: 切換目標時略過目前無法步行抵達的對象。
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.zhc: 切换目标时跳过当前无法步行抵达的对象。
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.ru: При переборе объектов пропускается всё, до чего сейчас нельзя дойти.
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.th: การเลื่อนดูวัตถุจะข้ามสิ่งที่ตอนนี้เดินไปไม่ถึง
Entity cycling skips anything you cannot.pt: A navegação entre entidades ignora tudo o que você não consegue alcançar a pé no momento.

Exits that lead to the same place are me.en: Exits that lead to the same place are merged into the closest one.
Exits that lead to the same place are me.ja: 同じ場所へつながる出口を、最も近いひとつにまとめます。
Exits that lead to the same place are me.fr: Les sorties menant au même endroit sont regroupées en la plus proche.
Exits that lead to the same place are me.it: Le uscite che portano allo stesso luogo vengono unite in quella più vicina.
Exits that lead to the same place are me.de: Ausgänge zum selben Ort werden zum nächstgelegenen zusammengefasst.
Exits that lead to the same place are me.es: Las salidas que llevan al mismo lugar se agrupan en la más cercana.
Exits that lead to the same place are me.ko: 같은 장소로 이어지는 출구를 가장 가까운 하나로 합칩니다.
Exits that lead to the same place are me.zht: 通往同一地點的出口會合併為最近的一個。
Exits that lead to the same place are me.zhc: 通往同一地点的出口会合并为最近的一个。
Exits that lead to the same place are me.ru: Выходы, ведущие в одно место, объединяются в ближайший.
Exits that lead to the same place are me.th: ทางออกที่ไปยังที่เดียวกันจะรวมเป็นทางออกที่ใกล้ที่สุด
Exits that lead to the same place are me.pt: Saídas que levam ao mesmo lugar são agrupadas na mais próxima.

Hides layer transitions, the spots that.en: Hides layer transitions, the spots that move you between levels of the same map, from entity cycling.
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.ja: 同じマップ内の階層を移動する地点（レイヤー遷移）を、対象の切り替えから除外します。
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.fr: Masque les transitions de couche, ces points qui vous font passer d'un niveau à l'autre d'une même carte, lors du parcours des entités.
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.it: Nasconde dallo scorrimento delle entità le transizioni di livello, i punti che ti spostano tra i piani della stessa mappa.
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.de: Blendet Ebenenübergänge, also Stellen, die dich zwischen Ebenen derselben Karte bringen, beim Durchschalten der Objekte aus.
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.es: Oculta al recorrer entidades las transiciones de capa, los puntos que te llevan entre niveles del mismo mapa.
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.ko: 같은 맵 안에서 층을 이동하는 지점(레이어 전환)을 대상 전환에서 숨깁니다.
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.zht: 在切換目標時隱藏圖層轉換，也就是在同一地圖不同層之間移動的地點。
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.zhc: 在切换目标时隐藏图层转换，也就是在同一地图不同层之间移动的地点。
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.ru: Скрывает при переборе объектов переходы между слоями — места, ведущие на другой уровень той же карты.
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.th: ซ่อนจุดเปลี่ยนชั้น ซึ่งเป็นจุดที่พาคุณไปยังอีกชั้นของแผนที่เดียวกัน ออกจากการเลื่อนดูวัตถุ
Hides layer transitions, the spots that.pt: Oculta da navegação entre entidades as transições de camada, pontos que levam a outro nível do mesmo mapa.

When on, stick clicks go to the game for.en: When on, stick clicks go to the game for walk or run and encounters, and their mod functions move to mod mode. When off, the right stick click toggles the pathfinding filter and the left stick click toggles audio beacons.
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.ja: オンにすると、スティックの押し込みはゲーム側の歩き・ダッシュ切り替えとエンカウント切り替えに使われ、MODの機能はMODモードに移ります。オフにすると、右スティック押し込みで経路探索フィルター、左スティック押し込みで音声ビーコンを切り替えます。
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.fr: Activé, les clics de stick sont transmis au jeu (marche ou course, rencontres) et leurs fonctions du mod passent en mode mod. Désactivé, le clic du stick droit bascule le filtre de recherche de chemin et celui du stick gauche les balises audio.
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.it: Se attivo, i clic delle levette vanno al gioco (camminata o corsa e incontri) e le loro funzioni della mod passano alla modalità mod. Se disattivo, il clic della levetta destra attiva il filtro percorso e quello della levetta sinistra i segnali audio.
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.de: Wenn aktiv, gehen Stick-Klicks an das Spiel (Gehen oder Rennen und Zufallskämpfe) und ihre Mod-Funktionen wandern in den Mod-Modus. Wenn aus, schaltet der rechte Stick-Klick den Pfadfindungsfilter und der linke Stick-Klick die Audio-Signale um.
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.es: Si está activado, los clics de stick van al juego (caminar o correr y encuentros) y sus funciones del mod pasan al modo mod. Si está desactivado, el clic del stick derecho alterna el filtro de búsqueda de ruta y el del izquierdo, las balizas de audio.
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.ko: 켜면 스틱 누르기가 게임의 걷기·달리기 전환과 인카운트 전환에 쓰이고, 모드 기능은 모드 모드로 옮겨집니다. 끄면 오른쪽 스틱 누르기로 경로 탐색 필터를, 왼쪽 스틱 누르기로 오디오 비콘을 전환합니다.
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.zht: 開啟時，按壓搖桿會交給遊戲切換步行或奔跑與遇敵，Mod功能則移至Mod模式。關閉時，按壓右搖桿切換尋路篩選器，按壓左搖桿切換音訊信標。
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.zhc: 开启时，按压摇杆会交给游戏切换步行或奔跑与遇敌，Mod功能则移至Mod模式。关闭时，按压右摇杆切换寻路筛选器，按压左摇杆切换音频信标。
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.ru: Когда включено, нажатия стиков передаются игре (ходьба или бег и случайные бои), а функции мода переходят в режим мода. Когда выключено, нажатие правого стика переключает фильтр поиска пути, а левого — звуковые маяки.
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.th: เมื่อเปิด การกดสติ๊กจะส่งให้เกมใช้สลับเดินหรือวิ่งและการเผชิญหน้า และฟังก์ชันของม็อดจะย้ายไปอยู่ในโหมดม็อด เมื่อปิด การกดสติ๊กขวาจะสลับตัวกรองการค้นหาเส้นทาง และการกดสติ๊กซ้ายจะสลับสัญญาณเสียง
When on, stick clicks go to the game for.pt: Quando ativado, os cliques dos analógicos vão para o jogo (andar ou correr e encontros) e suas funções do mod passam para o modo mod. Quando desativado, o clique do analógico direito alterna o filtro de busca de caminho e o do esquerdo, os sinais de áudio.

Plays a ticking sound while experience c.en: Plays a ticking sound while experience counts up on the battle results screen.
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.ja: 戦闘結果画面で経験値が加算されている間、カウント音を鳴らします。
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.fr: Joue un tic-tac pendant que l'expérience s'additionne sur l'écran des résultats de combat.
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.it: Riproduce un ticchettio mentre l'esperienza aumenta nella schermata dei risultati della battaglia.
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.de: Spielt ein Ticken, während die Erfahrung auf dem Kampfergebnis-Bildschirm hochgezählt wird.
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.es: Reproduce un tictac mientras la experiencia se suma en la pantalla de resultados de batalla.
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.ko: 전투 결과 화면에서 경험치가 올라가는 동안 카운트 소리를 재생합니다.
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.zht: 戰鬥結果畫面累計經驗值時播放計數音效。
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.zhc: 战斗结果画面累计经验值时播放计数音效。
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.ru: Воспроизводит тиканье, пока на экране итогов боя начисляется опыт.
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.th: เล่นเสียงนับขณะค่าประสบการณ์เพิ่มขึ้นบนหน้าผลการต่อสู้
Plays a ticking sound while experience c.pt: Toca um tique-taque enquanto a experiência é somada na tela de resultados da batalha.

Volume of the experience counter ticking.it: Volume del ticchettio del contatore di esperienza.
Volume of the experience counter ticking.es: Volumen del tictac del contador de experiencia.
Volume of the experience counter ticking.zht: 經驗值計數音效的音量。
Volume of the experience counter ticking.zhc: 经验值计数音效的音量。
Volume of the experience counter ticking.th: ระดับเสียงนับค่าประสบการณ์
Volume of the experience counter ticking.pt: Volume do tique-taque do contador de experiência.
